A member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], this '''[[Human/Legends|Human]]''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After surviving [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], they did battle with [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Namman Cha]], pitting the power of [[Faalo's Will]] against their opponent.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This Jedi was created for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]. Unnamed, they were placed on a card demonstrating Faalo's Will.
